name: Closer ordinary mudcrab corpse approach with read-only focus diagnostic

replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local goal=util.vector3(45846.68,84309.72,80.32)
local path=nil
local index=1
local timer=0
local age=0
local last=self.position
local stuck=0
local attempts=0
local expected=nil
local function route()
 local status,p=nearby.findPath(self.position,goal,{{agentBounds=Actor.getPathfindingAgentBounds(self),destinationTolerance=20}})
 print('MudcrabCorpsePath query status='..tostring(status)..' count='..#p)
 if #p>0 then local endp=p[#p];local d=endp-goal;if math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y)<30 then path=p;index=1;attempts=attempts+1;print('MudcrabCorpsePath ready points='..#p);return end end
end
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 age=age+dt;timer=timer+dt;if timer<0.1 then return end;local elapsed=timer;timer=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during mudcrab corpse loot')
 local corpse=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6c927))
 if not corpse or not corpse:isValid() then return end
 assert(Actor.isDead(corpse),'Original mudcrab must already be dead')
 goal=corpse.position
 local source=Actor.inventory(corpse);local player=Actor.inventory(self)
 if not expected then
  expected={{}}
  for _,item in ipairs(source:getAll()) do
   expected[item.recordId]=player:countOf(item.recordId)+source:countOf(item.recordId)
   print('MudcrabCorpse original item='..item.recordId..' count='..source:countOf(item.recordId)..' playerBefore='..player:countOf(item.recordId))
  end
  assert(next(expected),'Source corpse has no loot')
 end
 local transferred=#source:getAll()==0
 for id,count in pairs(expected) do if player:countOf(id)~=count then transferred=false end end
 if transferred then print('MudcrabCorpse loot transferred');return end
 if core.isWorldPaused() or age<3 then return end
 local finish=goal-self.position
 if math.sqrt(finish.x*finish.x+finish.y*finish.y)<45 then
  local target=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6c927))
  assert(target and target:isValid(),'Original mudcrab missing')
  print('MudcrabCorpse arrived missing=0 pos='..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' crabHealth='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(target).current)
  local aim=target:getBoundingBox().center
  local ray=nearby.castRenderingRay(camera.getPosition(),aim,{{ignore=self}})
  print('MudcrabCorpse focus center='..tostring(aim)..' camera='..tostring(camera.getPosition())..' range='..(aim-camera.getPosition()):length()..' ray='..tostring(ray.hitObject));local v=aim-self.position
  local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local angle=math.atan2(f.y*v.x-f.x*v.y,f.x*v.x+f.y*v.y)
  local c=aim-camera.getPosition();local pitch=-math.atan2(c.z,math.sqrt(c.x*c.x+c.y*c.y))
  if math.abs(angle)<.035 and math.abs(pitch-camera.getPitch())<.035 then print('MudcrabCorpse facing crab') end
  print(string.format('MudcrabCorpse look x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(angle*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor((pitch-camera.getPitch())*256+.5)))))
  return
 end
 if not path then route();return end
 local progress=(self.position-last):length();last=self.position
 if self.controls.movement>0 and progress<1 then stuck=stuck+elapsed else stuck=0 end
 if stuck>3 then print('MudcrabCorpsePath replan');path=nil;stuck=0;assert(attempts<12,'Mudcrab path blocked repeatedly');return end
 while index<=#path do local v=path[index]-self.position;if math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.y*v.y)<14 then index=index+1 else break end end
 if index>#path then path=nil;return end
 local v=path[index]-self.position;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local angle=math.atan2(f.y*v.x-f.x*v.y,f.x*v.x+f.y*v.y)
 print(string.format('MudcrabCorpsePath aim x=%d y=%d point=%d pos=%.2f,%.2f,%.2f distance=%.2f',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(angle*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(-camera.getPitch()*256+.5))),index,self.position.x,self.position.y,self.position.z,finish:length()))
 if math.abs(angle)<.04 then print('MudcrabCorpsePath facing') end
end}}}}
